scope: Input y²=f(x) with deg f=2g+1, supplied prime-order subgroup, and g tending to infinity. This is N^o(1) for N=p^g and L_N(1/2,O(1)) for log p=O(g log g).
statement: For odd prime p and growing genus g on squarefree imaginary hyperelliptic models, the specified prime-subgroup algorithm has expected bit complexity exp(O(log p+sqrt(g log p log(2g)))) without the ambient order.
